title: A Quest for Reason | Litmus '23 | esSENSE Global
tags: role of religion in human history
description:
In a land rich with history and culture, another story unfolds: the silent conflict between ancient religious narratives and the promise of progress and enlightenment.

This short film from Pale Blue Thoughts explores:

How politics and religion fuel each other.

Why challenging orthodoxy is essential for true secularism.

Voices from history and today who stood for science, reason, and human rights.

The path toward a genuinely secular, rational, and enlightened future.

👉 Watch this powerful journey into the clash of faith, politics, and reason. This video titled the Quest Of Reason was created as part of the promotion of Litmus '23 which was held on 1 October 2023 at Nisagandhi Auditorium, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - This was the World's Biggest Atheist Meet in God's Own Country.

Script: Rakesh Unnikrishnan
Voice Recording: Praveen Ravi
Narration: Nishad Kaippally
Video Editing: Sinto Thomas
Direction: Tony Phillip
